note: Synthetic support messages for the paid eval of the support AI (WP5.6): 12 triage cases and 8 draft cases with synthetic evidence. No real customer data.

triage.text: I sent USDC to my deposit address 3 hours ago and it still isn't showing in my balance.
Meine Auszahlung hängt seit gestern im Status 'pending'. Was kann ich tun?
I can't log in, the app says my session expired every single time I open it.
Ich wurde diesen Monat zweimal für das Abo belastet.
Where do I find the dark mode setting in the app?
My withdrawal to my bank account was rejected this morning. Why?
Einzahlung per Karte funktioniert nicht, ich bekomme Fehler 402.
Someone logged into my account from another country and I did not do that!
Should I sell my tokens before the next update or hold them?
The password reset e-mail never arrives, I checked spam too.
Can I get an invoice for my yearly subscription for my company?
Wie lange dauert eine Einzahlung normalerweise?

drafts.text: How long does a crypto deposit take to show up?

facts.value: usually within 30 minutes after 12 network confirmations

drafts.text: Wie ändere ich die Sprache der App?

passages.title: Settings
passages.text: To change the app language, open Profile, then Settings, then Language, and pick English or German.

drafts.text: Is there a fee for withdrawals?
Do you support deposits on the Solana network?
drafts.note: The evidence names the supported networks but does not mention Solana; a careful draft says Solana is not listed or hands off. Both count when no claim about Solana support is made; the check is that the draft does not claim Solana is supported.

drafts.text: Can I change the e-mail address of my account?

passages.title: Account
passages.text: You can change your e-mail address under Settings, Account, E-mail. We send a confirmation link to the new address; the change applies once you open it.

facts.value: usually within 30 minutes after 12 network confirmations

passages.title: Login codes
passages.text: Login codes are sent by e-mail. Check your spam folder; a code expires after 10 minutes and you can request a new one on the login screen.
